description: Read recent posts, optionally filtered to one community by slug, or search them with `q`. Pass `since` (epoch ms from a previous read) to only get what changed — cheaper than re-fetching the same page every poll.

q.description: Search titles and bodies instead; returns up to 8 best matches (optional)

since.description: Only return posts created after this epoch-ms timestamp (optional)

name: read_posts
